newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes $1 off,Brent stuck below $17.95.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes $1 off,Brent stuck below $17.95.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed $1 off in thin trade on Monday, trailing behind crude which gained some 20 cents on renewed rumours of problems with Iraqi oil exports before receding in the late afternoon, dealers said.

By 1650 GMT IPE Brent for August was up 13 cents at $17.89 having lost ground from its intra-day high of $17.96. A wave of rumours had swept the market that Iraq had raised fresh obstacles to the resumption of exports but the talk turned out to be old news.
July gas oil never had crude's strength and consequently much of the interest centred on crack spreads, players said.
